description_for_human: Creative Intelligence Platform — build worlds, generate characters, create quests with 54 AI tools.
description_for_model: Arcanea is a creative intelligence platform with 54 MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools for world-building. It can generate characters, locations, creatures, quests, artifacts, magic systems, and analyze faction dynamics. All creations auto-link into coherent narratives. The platform includes 20 collections of original mythology in the Library of Arcanea, a 10-gate progression system, 7 Academy Houses, and 14 public repositories. Use the MCP bridge at /api/worlds/mcp-bridge to call tools via REST.
